verdict.rationale: The README shows a one-line terminal command, `llama cli -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF`, that pulls a model and starts a session, and it showcases an interactive VLM session with `llama cli`. A community user independently confirms using the CLI interactively, loading images mid-chat via '/image image.png'. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the interactive chat mode (chat templates, in-session commands, conversation controls), and independent corroboration of the current `llama cli` text-chat flow rather than the older mtmd-cli vision tool.
